name: Patrol Line
intel: Normal patrol. Cover the bend corners — enemies slow down on turns.

name: Fast Approach
intel: Signal Runners enter the bend. They bunch up at corners — this is your window.

name: Heavy Pressure
intel: Heavy Shells arrive. They are slow but absorb damage — target them early.

name: Rush and Brace
intel: Mixed column. Runners sprint ahead of the heavies — don't let either slip through.

name: Bend Assault
intel: Final push. All three types together. Prioritise tanks while Rapid handles runners.
